name: J012418-711202
notes: Real ASKAP H I 21-cm absorption toward J012418-711202 from the GASKAP-HI pilot (CSIRO DAP collection 75305, product 97358171, 30 spectra; this is the highest-significance rating-B sightline). The archive column named optical_depth is normalised absorption exp(-tau) on a 0.977 km/s grid; pipeline/votable_to_spectrum.py converts it to tau = -ln(opacity). The line is unresolved at one channel, so tau and width are degenerate: only the product tau*dv is constrained.
